name: 4Login for Secure And Smart Access
author: 4login

sections.description:
Secure your site with a strong password — without the hassle of remembering it.
With 4Login, you get simple yet powerful authentication that connects to an external server.
Simply create your own pattern to generate a dynamic password that updates every 60 minutes.

Please refer to the operation Instructions for instructions on how to use 4Login.

External services

This plugin connects to an external API to enable 4Login authentication.
When logging in with 4Login, the plugin sends the 4Login App Service ID, the user’s email address, and a dynamic password .
These credentials are entered directly within the WordPress login interface.

This authentication service is provided by Passlogy.
For more information, please review our
Terms of Service and
Privacy Policy.
sections.installation: Please refer to the installation Instructions for details on how to install 4Login.
sections.faq:
I entered the correct password, but I can’t log in to WordPress.

  • Please check if your WordPress server is properly connected to the 4Login server.
  • If there are no connection issues, make sure you are entering the email address you registered along with your 4Login code.
